text:
sam: Quick callout — onboarding/sampleapp is getting a lot of duplicated webhook deliveries after users hit the \u201creplay last prompt\u201d button repeatedly. Backend logs show many 429s followed by immediate retries from the client.

nina: Which SDK and version? Any streaming involved?

sam: node sdk 1.4.2 in the web sample. Pure sync generation. Users hit replay a few times while the previous request is still pending.

tyler: Sounds like missing client-side debounce + no idempotency. Node SDK currently sends no idempotency header by default. Python has a small helper but parity was never landed for node.

lou: Can we hack the sampleapp to do two quick things: (1) add a 500ms UI debounce on the replay button, (2) persist a lastRequestFingerprint in sessionStorage and avoid resending identical payloads within a TTL? Both are low-risk.

sam: Agree. Also the server is returning some 429s without Retry-After in a subset of hits: example log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-19T14:22:10Z] POST /v1/generate 429 - x-req: r_xyz123 - body: {"error":"rate_limited"}
```
No Retry-After header. Makes client retry loops aggressive.

nina: That could be from fast-fail fallback on busy hosts in smart-routing. Might not attach Retry-After when we short-circuit. Ops should check.

tyler: For SDK changes I propose: default client retry policy becomes exponential backoff with full jitter, and add an opt-in withIdempotency(key) helper that sets X-Redwood-Idempotency or Idempotency-Key header for create-like calls. Example backoff config: 
```js
{ maxRetries: 4, baseMs: 200, maxMs: 2500, jitter: true }
```

sam: Can idempotency keys be scoped to non-streaming requests only? Streaming semantics differ (can't dedupe partial streams).

lou: Yes, only non-streaming, idempotency makes sense for discrete synchronous ops. We'll update docs to call that out.

nina: I'll raise a ticket to audit the smart-routing path for missing Retry-After. In the meantime, sampleapp + sdk mitigations should reduce duplicate delivery incidents.

tyler: I'll open the node-sdk PR for withIdempotency + backoff defaults and add unit tests asserting header presence and that streaming requests don't set the header.

lou: I'll change the sampleapp to store a fingerprint + UI debounce and return a quick toast instead of resending the same request. Also add server-side dedupe fallback for the webhook receivers (idempotency TTL 5m).

sam: Great. Ops-bot — can you create a staging smoke test to simulate 50 concurrent replays and ensure webhook dedupe works?

ops-bot: Created test run: replay-debounce-staging -> queued.

nina: Timeline? Would like SDK patch + sampleapp change in staging by Thursday so docs can be updated before next onboarding wave.

tyler: Targeting PRs today, reviews tomorrow. Will ping here if any blockers.

sam: Thanks everyone. Small wins here should drastically cut duplicate actions. :thumbsup:
